request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: supporting landing-page image for a franchise technology section
Primary request: Create a realistic editorial scene that communicates one integrated operating view across used-vehicle sales, dealer-carried financing, vehicle service, collections, customer communication, reporting, and compliance.
Scene/backdrop: a contemporary but plausible dealership operations workspace adjacent to a service lane, with several large monitors showing abstract dashboards, vehicle inventory tiles, workflow lines, and service status panels.
Subject: the connected operational environment itself; no identifiable people as the hero subject.
Style/medium: high-end documentary commercial photography, natural materials and believable screen glow, not glossy sci-fi.
Composition/framing: landscape 4:3, layered depth, strongest visual interest in the center-right, clean negative space at upper left for page composition; must survive a mobile 4:3 crop.
Lighting/mood: bright natural daylight with controlled cool-blue ambient light and one restrained warm-orange accent.
Color palette: deep navy, Byrider-like medium blue, white, graphite, small orange accents; no exact logos.
Constraints: no readable financial figures, no names, no logos, no trademarks, no vehicle license plates, no branded uniforms, no certificates, no testimonial cues, no implication that this is an actual Byrider facility or proprietary interface.
Avoid: futuristic holograms, cyberpunk, fake readable UI text, distorted screens, staged handshake poses, stock-photo smiles, visual clutter.

Usage: Technology; Visualize connected sales, financing, service, and reporting without fabricating proof.
Constraints: This is illustrative supporting imagery, not documentary evidence. Do not invent client staff, testimonials, logos, certificates, or before/after results. Preserve room and subject placement required by the page composition.
